symbols.name: IApplicationCache
symbols.summary: Resolves precomposed collection handles from the immutable startup catalog without lookup I/O.
symbols.remarks: Resolution performs no source execution or provider I/O. The returned collection handle can be reused across requests and preserves its declared value contract.

symbols.name: GetCollection(string)
symbols.summary: Resolves the reusable handle for a declared typed collection.

parameters.description: The declared collection name, compared using invariant case equivalence.

returns.description: The precomposed typed collection handle. Resolution does not read or load an entry.

parameters.description: The declared collection name, compared using invariant case equivalence.

returns.description: The precomposed typed collection handle. Resolution does not read or load an entry.

symbols.name: GetBinaryCollection(string)
symbols.summary: Resolves the reusable handle for a declared raw binary collection.

parameters.description: The declared collection name, compared using invariant case equivalence.

returns.description: The precomposed raw binary collection handle. Resolution does not open a stream.
